answer: Require every agent identity to stake a refundable bond that is slashed on proven duplicate behaviour, verified through a slow, costly proof-of-work identity check tied to a unique hardware-backed key. Like a reef that only grows where conditions are proven over time, reputation accrues slowly, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital and compute, while a comet-fast flood of new identities earns no trust until it survives the same quartz-hard verification window as everyone else.
